svg.title: Exploration, Treefinement, Self-Improvement and Critique workflow
svg.desc: Four rounded base frames form a 2x2 workflow. Exploration contains a Dafny source code crop, examples, LLM, verifier, and three translation outcomes connected by black arrows. Treefinement contains an unverified program, examples, a blue refinement tree, a program+errors block, refine module, and verified output. Self-Improvement contains three rows of new examples feeding better exploration/treefinement/critique. Critique contains verified input, three comparison/exploit/rule-based modules, and verified aligned output. Outer arrows form a clockwise loop among frames. Confirmed SAM mappings replace constructed draft image/icon blocks only: original figure object crops at their source coordinates are bound to matching asset_sam_region IDs while keeping base frames, labels, arrows, and borders.

g.desc: Inventory: title, source label, Dafny source code card, examples stack, LLM network icon, verifier gear/check icon, translations heading, three outcome code cards labeled Invalid, Unverified, Verified. Relationships: source and examples point into LLM; LLM points to verifier; verifier branches to three translation outcomes. Horizontal symmetry around the middle LLM-to-verifier line with upper and lower branches.

Inventory: title, unverified card, examples, blue branching tree of candidate boxes, program+errors panel, refine module, final verified code card. Relationships: unverified card feeds a left-to-right branching tree; lower program+errors and refine module support refinement; tree output goes to verified card. Symmetry basis is a left-to-right pipeline with vertically stacked tree levels around a central horizontal blue path.

Inventory: title, three text rows: new translation examples, new correction examples, new exploit examples; each row has a cluster of example crops and a black rightward arrow to better exploration/treefinement/critique. Relationships: row-wise horizontal mapping from example set to improvement target. Symmetry basis is three evenly spaced horizontal bands.

Inventory: title, verified input crop, arrow to a three-row module stack (Comparison, Exploit, Rule-based), arrow to verified+aligned output crop. The module stack uses LLM network icons for comparison/exploit and gear icon for rule-based. Relationships: verified input is critiqued by three aligned modules, producing verified and aligned output. Symmetry basis is vertical stacking of three equal module rows centered between input and output.
